head_geometry_v2.selection: rejected: generated a full body from bust references, leaving insufficient facial detail

selection.reason: Isolated head with clear facial geometry and dedicated paint; fitted to the existing rig.

scope: Complete production: three tiers, accepted Male Peasant v2 civilian motion, six clips, textures, LODs and verified game integration; attacks/casting/weapons excluded.

required_components.evidence: review/native/standing.png; open ragged sleeveless vest, exposed chest, torn trousers, low boots; no weapon

user_acceptance_record.scope: Bedraggled Human m620 with the separate head and corrected solid hair

animation_source.reason: Explicit user choice of accepted civilian replacement; retain source timings and fit posture/contacts to new clothing/body.

corrections.issue: Imported donor actions had the same names as destination roles, so replacement deleted the source action.
corrections.fix: Rename imported source actions before baking target roles; assert actual Walking movement and upright Standing height.

corrections.issue: Body retexture omitted four hair faces and one zero-area hair triangle; head retexture omitted only the zero-area triangle.
corrections.fix: Remove zero-area face; preserve all real hair faces through the independently verified head return.

corrections.issue: Head Smart UV had 284 overlapping raster texels.
corrections.fix: Re-unfold hair, isolate folded triangles, reproject original paint and verify zero overlap at 1K and 2K.

corrections.issue: Provisional rigging UV remained first in the export, overriding the selected painted UVs.
corrections.fix: Retain only UVMap before export; final structure asserts no second texture-coordinate set.

corrections.issue: A few painted vest frays shared upper-trouser texture charts and stayed green on B/C.
corrections.fix: Include only green cloth texels and their seam padding near the vest hem in the vest mask; assert no skin enters the mask.

corrections.finding: User reported widespread holes in the hair.
corrections.cause: Sparse disconnected strips around an undersized scalp.
corrections.change: Closed fitted hair volume, textured from the existing hair, with the lower rim fitted inside the head.

broader_regression.scope: Historical original-body run; not rerun for the head revision.

validation.normal_and_half_speed_playback: review/playback/ (head-v2 recording; all six action keyframes verified unchanged in hair-v3)
validation.head: review/validation/head_v2.json

head_revision.reason: User requested separately modelled and textured head after rejecting the smeared face close-up.
head_revision.body_motion_scope: Preserve body and six civilian clips.
head_revision.retry: Isolated head reference with no shoulders or clothing; Smart Topology for separated facial/hair geometry.
head_revision.neck: Continuous connected skin; 53 shared vertices, rigid cranium and blended neck.
head_revision.textures: Dedicated 2K head; existing body paint stored at shared 2K height.
head_revision.budget_exception: 15K LOD0 and 4128x2048 merged maps preserve the face and continuous hair volume; body and animation unchanged.
